AccountBudgetPolicyDraft.invariant: One currency and MANUAL exact source. reference_amount equals manual_capital_reference as compatibility alias. Server recomputes budget_total; mismatched supplied summary rejects422. Inherit unchanged ratio/group weights only via exact prior policy/allocation. No cash movement.
AccountBudgetPolicyDraft.name: AccountBudgetPolicyDraft

BudgetAllocationPreview.invariant: Persisted immutable typed body carries exact proposal/source/policy/manual amount/ratio/total/splits and whole AccountCut plus reservation frontier. Strict source and heads verified. INVALID/UNKNOWN/STALE/EXPIRED cannot confirm. VALID is planning eligibility only, never trading readiness or authorization.
BudgetAllocationPreview.name: BudgetAllocationPreview

BudgetAllocationProposal.invariant: Complete account/allocation set with exact predecessor and manual-reference source; server never obtains weights by symbol/current equity. Partial UI edits expanded from exact prior immutable allocation; any unknown, missing or unsafe resource blocks confirm. Supplied computed values verified rather than trusted.
BudgetAllocationProposal.name: BudgetAllocationProposal

BudgetRatio.invariant: Unsigned canonical integer strings; denominator>0; gcd=1; 0<=numerator<=denominator; exact rational, never binary float or decimal percent authority.
BudgetRatio.name: BudgetRatio

BudgetRoundingTrace.invariant: Parallel arrays unique/sorted by permanent ID; exact_quotas are reduced rational strings. Parent conserved; no residual hidden or converted into cash.
BudgetRoundingTrace.name: BudgetRoundingTrace

ContractRef.invariant: 引用精確版本，禁止 latest
ContractRef.name: ContractRef

GroupStrategyAllocation.invariant: allocation_ratio is a share of rounded budget_total. weight_percent is exact rational*100 decimal alias only when terminating exactly; otherwise omit alias. Unique same-account group and unique deployment membership. Sum strategy budgets + strategy_unallocated = group budget, deterministic split, no borrowed lots/funds.
GroupStrategyAllocation.name: GroupStrategyAllocation

Money.invariant: Decimal 字串、ISO currency、明確 rounding policy
Money.name: Money

ResourceAvailabilityByGroup.invariant: Amounts are normalized disjoint resource claims from qualified policy, never double-subtract overlapping margin/position/order resources. safe_transferable=max(0,min(unencumbered_budget,unencumbered_cash,account_safe_available)-exit/safety reserve). Missing/stale/UNKNOWN claims => UNKNOWN and safe_transferable=0 with no transfer/new risk. Budget changes alone transfer zero.
ResourceAvailabilityByGroup.name: ResourceAvailabilityByGroup

StrategyBudgetAllocation.invariant: allocation_ratio is a share of rounded parent group budget, not account budget or actual equity. weight_percent exact terminating display alias only; unique deployment belongs exact group/account/env; strategy_budget must match deterministic result.
StrategyBudgetAllocation.name: StrategyBudgetAllocation
